text: Leaching parameters can and should be calibrated to balance competing incentives, rewarding honest attribution while retaining enough skin in the game to deter frivolous or strategic references.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Citation Honesty Mechanisms in Weighted Directed Acyclic Graph Governance (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6269518

isBasedOn.name: Citation Honesty Mechanisms in Weighted Directed Acyclic Graph Governance

abstract: The insight from the WDAG framework is that leaching parameters can and should be calibrated to balance competing incentives. Thus, rewarding honest attribution while maintaining sufficient skin-in-the-game to prevent frivolous or strategic references.
